name: Kettlebell Lunge
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at your sides, or one in the goblet position.
Step forward into a lunge, lowering until both knees are near 90 degrees.
Keep the torso upright and front knee over the ankle.
Drive through the front heel to return. Alternate legs.
longevityNotes: Single-leg strength is balance insurance — the ability to catch yourself on one leg prevents falls. Train lunges for control, not maximal load.
overview: Kettlebell Lunge is a beginner single-leg exercise for the quadriceps, performed with a kettlebell. Training one leg at a time builds balance and evens out side-to-side differences.
